title: DUX Behavior Object
description: A DUX object representing a specific, observable action or set of actions taken by a user or system. Behaviors are the 'what happened' in a user journey.

dux_id.description: Unique identifier for the DUX object, following the format DUX-B-[timestamp]-[uuid]

dux_version.description: The version of the DUX schema.

name.description: A concise, descriptive name for the behavior.

description.description: A detailed, narrative description of the behavior, explaining what happened, who was involved, and the context in which it occurred.

actors.description: The individuals or systems performing the behavior.

context.description: The situational context in which the behavior occurred.

evidence.description: A list of direct quotes or references from the source transcript that support the existence and description of this behavior.

provenance_id.description: The DUX ID of the Provenance object that sources this Behavior.
